name: Weathered Blacksteel Helmet
prompt: Create a single medieval steel knight helmet as a new editable 3D Blender object: a rounded forged black-metal skull, prominent brow, narrow horizontal eye slit, hinged angular cheek plates, nose guard, protective neck rim and metal rivets. Metallic almost-black gunmetal finish, polished battered edges, hammer dents and scratches. Clearly shaped like wearable head armor rather than a building, and without a display base. Save the Blender project and rendered preview, then open the new model in the Blender viewport.
